name: jev-skill-gate
trigger: before responding, check the skills index is under 2.5 KB; if a task doesn't match auto_load, open a fresh scoped session

name: jev-context-economy
trigger: per-call token hygiene: batch calls, grep-then-read, cap output, compress at boundaries

name: jev-prompt-budget-audit
trigger: audit fixed prompt cost; cut one toolset/skill; re-measure under budget

name: jev-context-firewall
trigger: push bulk extraction/analysis off the main context; only digests return

name: jev-test-output-triage
trigger: run tests/logs through a summary reporter; only failures reach context

name: jev-source-digest
trigger: web/page sources: extract bounded, file, digest in code, cite by line range
